<function name="ViewModelDrawn" parent="WEAPON" type="hook">
	<description>Called straight after the view model has been drawn. This is called before <page>GM:PostDrawViewModel</page> and <page>WEAPON:PostDrawViewModel</page>.

See <page>WEAPON:DrawWorldModel</page> for world model rendering.

See also <page>WEAPON:PreDrawViewModel</page> and <page>WEAPON:PostDrawViewModel</page>.

<rendercontext hook="true" type="3D"></rendercontext>
</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="ViewModel" type="Entity">Players view model</arg>
		<arg name="flags" type="number" added="2025.12.10">The <page text="STUDIO_">Enums/STUDIO</page> flags for this render operation.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
